gloss: hearing something for the first time; news to me

definitions.gloss: hearing something for the first time; news to someone
definitions.explanation: The experience of hearing a piece of information for the very first time. Used as a response to express that something is new and surprising to the listener.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初耳|はつみみ}だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{初耳|はつみみ}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I had no idea he changed jobs — that's the first I've heard of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初耳|はつみみ}で、⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was surprised — I had never heard that such a rule existed.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧ (first) and ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ (ear). Literally 'first ear' — the first time one's ears encounter the information.

Almost always used in the pattern ～⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初耳|はつみみ}だ. Very natural in conversation as a surprised response to unexpected news.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初耳|はつみみ}だ (That's news to me)
- ～⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{初耳|はつみみ}だ (I had no idea that...)
- {初耳|はつみみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (a story one hasn't heard before)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ is a more literal way to say 'I heard it for the first time'
- {初耳|はつみみ} is more concise and conversational
